cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the blanket. We'll get you warm first, then I'll supervise the heater reset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know how to reset it. Could you just leave the blanket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll take care of warmth, you take care of the switch. That's the sensible division.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Actually, could you hold the blanket round me while I reach behind the heater?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You direct the reset; I'll keep this tucked in. Just say you need my hands here, and I won't move them.

reason: Use B practical need for hands to make A adapt from supervisor to blanket holder; need admission comes from willing cooperation, without a new locked control point.
